component.name: Mouse Tailor
component.summary: Buttons, gestures, scrolling and battery for Logitech mice

description.p: Mouse Tailor is a settings app for Logitech mice on Linux. Choose what each button does, set up hold-and-swipe gestures, change scroll speed and direction, and see battery levels in the app, the top bar and Quick Settings. It is a front end for LogiOps, which does the work in the background.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Logitech.
Renamed to Mouse Tailor. New design, scroll speed and direction, and battery levels in the app, top bar and Quick Settings.
First release: button remapping, gestures, and device detection.
